name: Proscenia
summary: A theatre production desk with a cue runner stage, rehearsal calendar, seat map and budget
about: A complete production management app for a small theatre, opera or dance company, with sample data for a new play heading to opening night. Pressing GO runs the cue list on a drawn stage where curtains open, spotlights swing and the backdrop changes colour, and the app also schedules rehearsals, maps scenes to cast, sells seats and tracks props and the budget.
how: Open Production to watch the opening-night countdown tick and check each department's readiness rings
Open Cue sheet and press GO or the space bar: the stage preview runs each lighting, sound, fly and curtain cue
Drag rehearsal calls to a new day or time; an amber edge warns when someone called is not free
Click dots in the scene matrix to put a character in a scene and change each scene's status
In Box office pick seats on the map, then sell, hold or release them for any performance
Drag props and costumes from Needed to Ready, add expenses and watch the budget charts update
Edit the production, switch the paper or velvet theme and reset the demo data in Settings
